title.value: Deep learning, reinforcement learning, and world models
title.justification: The main topic discussed throughout the paper is deep learning, reinforcement learning, and how world models contribute to achieving human-level or super-human AI systems.
title.quote: Deep learning (DL) and reinforcement learning (RL) methods seem to be a part of indispensable factors to achieve human-level or super-human AI systems.

analysis.description: This paper reviews the discussions from the "Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning" session of the International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Brain Science, focusing on how these methods can help achieve human-like intelligence. The paper discusses different aspects of deep learning, reinforcement learning, and world models, emphasizing self-supervised learning, neural systems learning, and future AI directions.

type.justification: The paper summarizes empirical talks and discussions from a symposium, reflecting on recent studies and key technologies to achieve human-like intelligence.
type.quote: In this review, we summarize talks and discussions in the ‘‘Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning’’ session of the symposium, International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence and Brain Science.

name.justification: The paper discusses advances in artificial intelligence through the lens of deep learning and reinforcement learning, constituting the broader field of AI research.
name.quote: The symposium aimed to bring together researchers advancing the forefront of AI and neuroscience to identify the next targets in creating brain-like intelligence and further advancing neuroscience.

name.justification: The paper examines recent advances in deep learning, its relation to neural functions, and its use in the development of world models.
name.quote: In this review, we summarize talks and discussions in the ‘‘Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning’’ session of the symposium.

name.justification: The paper specifically analyzes reinforcement learning, its methodologies, and its interaction with AI systems to achieve advanced intelligence.
name.quote: Deep learning (DL) and reinforcement learning (RL) methods seem to be a part of indispensable factors to achieve human-level or super-human AI systems.

name.justification: World models are discussed as a crucial component for simulating real-world environments and achieving brain-like intelligence.
name.quote: A world model is a key to intelligent systems. We humans use a world model as a simulator in our brain.

name.justification: The paper mentions AlphaGo as a successful application of deep reinforcement learning, exemplifying its achievements in extensive search spaces like the game of Go.
name.quote: The most famous successful application is AlphaGo, which defeated the human European Go champion, where exhaustive searches are infeasible due to the huge search space.
